title: SuiteLocal Pro
brief: Third round of the SuiteLocal POS: professional, polished finish with a light/dark theme switch in every direction (button top right). Same sale screen and data across directions so they compare fairly. Only effects Qt/QSS can render.

artboards.title: Atelier
artboards.tradeoff: Refined and premium: navy + champagne, serif headings, product art, live KPIs and a floating ticket; the richest look, but the catalog area gets less room

artboards.title: Grafito
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for scanner and keyboard: graphite + emerald, big total, quick keys, weighed items and a status bar; very efficient but more utilitarian and less visual

artboards.title: Marfil
artboards.tradeoff: Warm and memorable: the sale reads like a real paper receipt, deep teal + copper, Mostrador/Mesas/Domicilios modes and a bottom action dock; ideal for cafés, slightly less dense for big catalogs

artboards.title: Atelier + Grafito
artboards.tradeoff: Atelier's premium look (navy + champagne rail, serif, product art, floating ticket) with Grafito's speed (big scanner field, quick keys, cash/change calculator, status bar); the densest screen of all, so it needs 1366 px or wider
